app.title: The Navigator
app.tagline: Help getting food assistance, one step at a time.

help.title: Need a real person? You are never stuck in this app.

verify.banner: These numbers are an unofficial estimate and still need to be checked against the official source. Always confirm with the official site and a real person.

offline.note: You're offline. You can still see your steps and dates, and estimates use the saved rules.

home.greeting: Welcome. I'm here to help you get food assistance.
home.choose: What would you like to do?
home.discoverTitle: See if I can get help
home.discoverDesc: Tell me your situation. I'll estimate what you might get.
home.applyDesc: I'll walk you through it, step by step, in plain words.
home.prepareDesc: Know what they'll ask and what to bring.
home.renewDesc: Never lose benefits to a missed renewal again.
home.modelOff: Smart help is off right now, so I'll use a few quick questions instead. Everything still works.

state.title: Where do you live?
state.desc: The rules are different in each state. Pick yours so everything I tell you is right for you.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.b1: I help you use the real food-assistance system. I am not the government and not a lawyer.
consent.b2: I ask for the least information I can, and I tell you why each time.
consent.b3: What you enter is saved only on this phone. You can delete all of it anytime, in one tap.
consent.b4: I always show you the official site and a real phone number, so you're never stuck here.

discover.title: Tell me what's going on
discover.prompt: In your own words, what is happening? For example: "I lost my job last month, I have two kids, and I'm behind on rent."
discover.useQuestions: Answer a few quick questions instead
discover.privacyNote: What you type is used only to understand your situation. It is not saved on our side. We save only your answers, on this phone.
discover.qIntro: You can skip any question. The more you share, the better the estimate.
discover.qHousehold: How many people live and eat together in your home? Count yourself.
discover.qIncome: About how much money comes into your home each month, before taxes?
discover.qEarned: How much of that is from a job or self-employment?
discover.qRent: How much do you pay for rent or mortgage each month?
discover.qUtilities: How much for utilities each month? (gas, electric, water, phone)
discover.qDepcare: Do you pay for childcare or adult care so you can work? How much a month?
discover.qElderly: Is anyone in your home 60 or older, or living with a disability?
discover.qImmigration: Is anyone applying not a U.S. citizen, or unsure about their status?

result.maybe: You might qualify — it's worth applying
result.unlikely: You may not qualify right now
result.unknown: I need a little more to estimate
result.estimatedOnPhone: Estimated on your phone using the saved rules.
result.otherNote: The Navigator only helps with food (SNAP) right now. For the things below, dial 211 — a real person can point you the right way.

human.title: This part needs a real person
human.body: Some questions can hurt your case if they're answered wrong. Please talk to a free helper about:

apply.title: Help me apply
apply.intro: I'll explain each part in plain words. When you're ready, you'll finish on the official site — I'll show you exactly where. Your place is saved automatically.
apply.notes: Your notes (saved on this phone only)
apply.notesPlaceholder: Jot down your answer so you have it ready…
apply.resume: Pick up where you left off
apply.finishBody: Finish your application on the official site. Bring your notes and papers. Benefits usually start from the day you apply, so don't wait even if a paper is missing.
apply.finishCta: Go to the official site to submit

docs.how: Don't have it? Here's what to do

prepare.title: Get ready for your interview
prepare.intro: After you apply, there is usually a short interview. Missing it is the most common reason eligible people get denied. Let's make sure you're ready.
prepare.dateLabel: When is your interview? (if you know)
prepare.practiceIntro: Read each question and think about your honest answer. Tap a question to see how to answer it.
prepare.yourAnswer: Your answer (saved on this phone only)

renew.title: Keep your benefits
renew.intro: Losing benefits to a missed renewal is one of the most common — and most preventable — problems. Let's make sure it doesn't happen to you.
renew.enrolledLabel: Date you were approved (on your approval notice)
renew.certEndLabel: Date your benefits end (from your notice, if you have it)
renew.computeNote: No exact end date? I'll estimate from the day you were approved — but always trust your official notice over my estimate.
renew.changeTitle: What to tell them between renewals

recert.title: Your renewal, step by step
recert.intro: Renewing on time keeps your benefits with no gap. I'll walk you through it, and your place is saved.
recert.finishBody: Send your renewal on the official site (or by phone) before your deadline. Bring your notes and your proof (ID, recent income, rent and utilities).

reminders.blocked: Your phone blocked reminders. I'll still show your dates here.

privacy.title: Your privacy & your data
privacy.minimal: We ask for the least we can, explain why, keep everything on your phone, and never sell your information.
privacy.stored: Saved on this phone right now:
privacy.deleteConfirm: This erases everything saved on this phone, including your answers and dates. It cannot be undone. Continue?
privacy.deleted: Done. Everything saved on this phone was deleted.

footer.disclaimer: The Navigator is not the government and not a lawyer. It helps you use the real system. Always confirm with the official site and a real person.
